title: Whole Grain Pasta with Cream Sauce and Seafood, Ready‑to‑Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain pasta with cream sauce and seafood is a ready‑to‑heat meal that can be quickly warmed in a microwave or on the stove. It contains whole‑grain pasta, a cream‑based sauce, and a mix of seafood such as shrimp, mussels, and squid. The dish provides complex carbohydrates, protein, and healthy fats.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole grain pasta offers more fiber and micronutrients than refined white pasta.
The cream sauce is often made with a blend of dairy cream and a touch of olive oil for a lighter texture.
Seafood is an excellent source of omega‑3 fatty acids, which support heart health.
The meal is designed for fast preparation: only 3‑5 minutes in the microwave are needed.
Ready‑to‑heat seafood pasta dishes are popular in the “quick and healthy” segment of the market.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole grain pasta supplies dietary fiber that promotes regular bowel movements.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Seafood adds complete protein essential for tissue repair and maintenance.

items.title: Omega‑3 fatty acids
items.content: Shrimp, mussels, and squid provide EPA and DHA, beneficial for heart and brain health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Both the pasta and seafood contain B12, B6, and niacin, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: The cream sauce contributes calcium, while seafood supplies vitamin D, both important for bone health.

items.title: Seafood allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to shrimp, mussels, or squid may experience severe reactions.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The prepared sauce can be high in salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: The cream sauce contains dairy, which may be problematic for those with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Proper heating
items.content: Insufficient heating may leave harmful bacteria alive, so follow the recommended heating time.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the portion in the microwave for about 3‑5 minutes or on a skillet, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately; optionally garnish with fresh herbs, a squeeze of lemon, or grated Parmesan cheese.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen product in a freezer at –18 °C. Once thawed, consume within 24 hours. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
